scope: RK3588 public-runtime CV candidate; no RKLLM qualification

base.identity: required BULLSEYE_BASE RepoDigest, recorded in builder-versions.json

host_tools.identity: required admitted ROCKCHIP_SDK_IMAGE RepoDigest, recorded in builder-versions.json

apt_source_modes.security_archive: Bullseye LTS ended on 2026-08-31. Live and mirror-ustc use the official archived bullseye-security suite, not currently maintained security updates. Only that archived source sets check-valid-until=no; APT signature verification remains enabled.
apt_source_modes.evidence: builder-versions.json records the actual mode and source URLs; evidence/dpkg-packages.tsv freezes resolved versions. Live and mirror-ustc modes use archived security packages and retain APT signature verification but are not reproducible package snapshots.

cmake_wheel.evidence: evidence/cmake-wheel.json records the selected download source and verified artifact hash; the PyPI URL remains the primary artifact identity.

ffmpeg.evidence: All download sources must match the same official release SHA256. evidence/ffmpeg-source.json, ffmpeg-manifest.json and builder-versions.json record the selected source and actual URL.

archive.identity_verification: The downloaded archive's content tree was independently reconstructed and matched the official commit API tree. This binds the locked archive SHA256 to the source tree; it is not a Git checkout. The builder rechecks the archive SHA256 rather than repeating that tree reconstruction.

mpp.evidence: Git mode verifies HEAD and commit epoch; archive mode verifies the locked official GitHub archive SHA256 and does not claim a Git checkout. Optional MPP_ARCHIVE_URL changes transport only; actual and primary URLs are retained in evidence/rockchip-source-mpp.json and builder-versions.json. Archive builds retain upstream's missing-VCS version text, so binary equality with Git builds is not claimed.

rga.evidence: Only include/rga, lib/librga.so and the librga license are copied from the RepoDigest-bound SDK. The rk3588 media runtime lock and seal verify required header, library, ELF and license identities. evidence/rockchip-source-rga.json and builder-versions.json record the SDK and official source provenance.
